prompt:
A high-fidelity visual design mockup of a MOBILE WEB PAGE, portrait phone viewport, full-bleed screen design. Flat screen design only: no phone hardware frame, no browser chrome, no hands, no device photograph, no shadow around the screen. It is a birthday party invitation page.

STRUCTURE, top to bottom, as regions of a web page. There is no navigation bar.

REGION 1, the full screen background: a warm sun-bleached sand-cream ground with a fine canvas grain, like a bright boatyard floor in summer. It surrounds everything with generous margins.

REGION 2, floating on that sand and occupying the middle 60% of the screen, centred, with clear sand margin on the left and right: one deep varnished navy-blue wooden nameboard shaped as a horizontal plaque with softly rounded corners, casting a soft warm shadow on the sand beneath it. Its edge is a gilded rope moulding, a small brass bolt at each corner. Inside the plate, centred:
  a) The words HBD SUMMER PARTY in two stacked lines of heavy high-contrast signwriter's roman capitals, in real gold leaf with a bright chisel highlight and a hard dark signwriter's shade dropped down and right.
  b) Beneath, a small centred line of Korean text 어반피크닉 워터파티룸 · 분당서현 in pale gold.
  c) At the plate's base, 2026.08.28 FRI 17:00 in small tracked stencil letters engraved INTO the varnish.

REGION 3, overlapping and straddling the TOP edge of the navy plate, centred, large: a gilded emblem about half the screen width, a birthday cake with exactly FIVE slim lit candles framed inside a circular life ring, drawn in flat gold-leaf signwriter grammar with two-tone chisel facets, its lower half over the navy plate and its upper half over the sand. The five candle flames are the ONLY warm orange in the image.

REGION 4, on the sand directly below the plate: a single even horizontal row of exactly FIVE identical small gold five-pointed stars, evenly spaced, all precisely the same size, none emphasised.

REGION 5, the lower 18% of the screen, full bleed: a band of clear pool water in warm teal-aqua with a rippling waterline and a pale crest highlight.

PALETTE, strictly: sun-bleached sand cream dominant, deep varnished navy, real gold leaf, pool aqua-teal, and one small flame orange only at the five candles. Warm, celebratory, orderly, classic maritime softened with warmth. Airy, symmetrical, generous negative space, absolutely not a busy collage.

No people, no faces, no logos, no photographs, no prices, no invented text beyond the words specified.
